import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset

# Set the style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Plot the survival rate by passenger class
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', data=titanic, ci=None)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender on the Titanic', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)

# Add legend

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Plot the survival rate by passenger class
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', data=titanic, ci=None)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender on the Titanic', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Gender')

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
